source_metadata.title: Pharmacology of Cefazolin and Other Cephalosporins in Patients with Renal Insufficiency

coverage.reference_list_reason: Bibliographic entries are provenance infrastructure rather than primary-study evidence atoms.

schema_gaps: The current schema has no dedicated field for standard deviation; SD values are retained in canonical statements and arm values but cannot be represented as typed uncertainty separate from CI/range.

The current quantitative-result model requires a single estimate even when the source reports only a range; range atoms therefore use the reported lower bound as estimate and the full reported range as interval_type=range.
Qualitative tolerability cannot be encoded as adverse_event because adverse_event requires a quantitative_result; it is represented as qualitative_result.
extraction_limitations: Small 1973 study; many results are graphical and do not provide exact point estimates for every participant.
Table 2 mixes present-study values with secondary literature; only present-study primary evidence was atomized as primary evidence.
No quantitative adverse-event table was reported.
Current-practice applicability is not encoded into atoms; it is handled in SEA appraisal.
